Ghatshila’s Stunning Hand-Painted Mud Houses | India’s Hidden Art Villages | Vlog EP 24
Experience the rich culture and artistry of Ghatshila, Jharkhand, through its beautiful hand-painted mud houses! These traditional homes, decorated with intricate patterns and vibrant colors, are a testament to the region’s artistic heritage and deep-rooted traditions.
What You’ll See in This Video:
Unique hand-painted mud houses – A glimpse into India’s rural art
Traditional craftsmanship & tribal culture – Meet the local artists
Scenic village life – Explore the serene surroundings
